Two of them (f0b74469, commits 39d69a9 and b25008f) also measured a SUPERSEDED objective: the cached MRR did not implement the evaluator's override_applied rule (notes/44 revision 5, section 0.8) and disagreed with the evaluator on 35 of 120 sup-train override sessions. The third (41bd8113, commit 27f3730) measured the corrected objective and its cache hash reproduces exactly, but it shares the degenerate key and is marked with them. The operative build is 41bd8113 at commit 483d514, ts 2026-08-30T01:38:00. No trial ran against any of these.

The lease symlinked lab/r0/artifacts/ms-marco-TinyBERT-L2-v2/{onnx/model_qint8_arm64.onnx,tokenizer.json} into the worktree. Those two files became TRACKED when the artifact was bundled for packaging, so git reported a typechange and every row of this run was stamped code_dirty -- a measurement invalidated by the isolation meant to protect it. The measurement itself is sound: the lease verified valid, agent_commit bff3b2d matched the isolated commit, agent_in_worktree was true, and every WATCHED input hashed identically before and after. It is recorded as non-citable anyway, because weakening the predicate to admit our own row is the failure the predicate exists to prevent. The holdout is ONE-SHOT and is NOT re-run to obtain a citable row.
